Text.Text: The conduits can flow through the ward again. Carry that lesson with your staff. You've finished my Infinite Conduit trials. I have no further work for you here.
The conduit trials require rank 50 in Saberstaff. Reach that rank, then return. Learn to guide the current before you test how much you can carry.

Practitioners in the medical sublevel are hoarding power instead of keeping it flowing. They also took the ward's ledger. Bring that record home. Defeat six Infinite Conduit Adepts in Dantooine, Medical Sublevel. Their defeat secures the Infinite Conduit Triage Ward Ledger; bring it back to me here in Dantooine, Medical Interior. I'll give you the Dantooine Medical Sublevel Key when you accept. Complete all five trials to earn the right to train Infinite Conduit.

Here's the Dantooine Medical Sublevel Key. Use 'Dantooine Medical Sublevel' in Dantooine, Abandoned Warehouse. My key grants access. Keep your party close to the entrance when you use it so they can enter with you. Defeat six Infinite Conduit Adepts, then return with the Infinite Conduit Triage Ward Ledger.

Most saber forms gather the Force and spend it in bursts. The conduit never gathers. The current passes through you -- into one blade, out the other, endlessly. Nothing pooled, nothing hoarded, nothing lost. It is the gentlest form I know and the least forgiving to learn, because the moment you try to keep any of it, it stops being a current and starts being a wound.

Use 'Dantooine Medical Sublevel' in Dantooine, Abandoned Warehouse. My key grants access. Keep your party close to the entrance when you use it so they can enter with you. Defeat six Infinite Conduit Adepts in Dantooine, Medical Sublevel. Their defeat secures the Infinite Conduit Triage Ward Ledger; bring it back to me here in Dantooine, Medical Interior.

Adepts who learned to hold the current instead of carrying it. Their strikes land heavier than they should, and they do not yield -- a dammed current doesn't know how to stop, only how to break. Don't try to outlast them; end each one cleanly and move on. And mind the kolto lines. The ward above still breathes through them.
Defeat six Infinite Conduit Adepts in Dantooine, Medical Sublevel. Their defeat secures the Infinite Conduit Triage Ward Ledger; bring it back to me here in Dantooine, Medical Interior.
You've defeated six Infinite Conduit Adepts. Let me see the Infinite Conduit Triage Ward Ledger.
The training record is back. We can see what went wrong. Your payment is ready. Speak to me again for the specialist trial when you're ready.

The specialists are using a kolto coupler to control the conduits. Recover it so the ward can use its own equipment again. Defeat five Infinite Conduit Specialists in Dantooine, Medical Sublevel. Their defeat secures the Infinite Conduit Kolto Conduit Coupler; bring it back to me here in Dantooine, Medical Interior.
Your key still grants access to Dantooine, Medical Sublevel. Defeat five Infinite Conduit Specialists to secure the Infinite Conduit Kolto Conduit Coupler, then return to me.

On the line, it lets two currents join without turbulence -- kolto or the Force, the principle is the same. In their hands it's a choke: starve the flow, then open it all at once and call the surge strength. Surge is not strength. It is debt, collected violently. Bring it back and the line will forgive everything.

Use 'Dantooine Medical Sublevel' in Dantooine, Abandoned Warehouse. My key grants access. Keep your party close to the entrance when you use it so they can enter with you. Defeat five Infinite Conduit Specialists in Dantooine, Medical Sublevel. Their defeat secures the Infinite Conduit Kolto Conduit Coupler; bring it back to me here in Dantooine, Medical Interior.

Specialists, not students. They ride the surge -- long stillness, then everything at once. Between surges they are slow, almost gentle. That is your moment, and they know it, so they will try to make you impatient. Be water. Wait with them. Then don't.
Defeat five Infinite Conduit Specialists in Dantooine, Medical Sublevel. Their defeat secures the Infinite Conduit Kolto Conduit Coupler; bring it back to me here in Dantooine, Medical Interior.
You've defeated five Infinite Conduit Specialists. Let me see the Infinite Conduit Kolto Conduit Coupler.
That equipment no longer serves their drills. Your payment is ready. Speak to me again for the warden trial when you're ready.

The warden holds the conduit chambers. Take back the ward sigil. Defeat the Infinite Conduit Warden in Dantooine, Medical Sublevel. Their defeat secures the Infinite Conduit Fractured Ward Sigil; bring it back to me here in Dantooine, Medical Interior. I recommend bringing two companions for this fight.

In Dantooine, Medical Sublevel, use the '???' challenge marker to call the Infinite Conduit Warden. Accept this assignment before using the marker. Bring two companions if you can. After the fight, return with the Infinite Conduit Fractured Ward Sigil.

A ward-keeper, once. One of ours. When the others began damming the current, he chose not to join them -- he chose to exceed them, to hold every drop of the deep ward's flow inside himself. What is left is a reservoir shaped like a man. There is a person in there somewhere. The pressure speaks for him now.
In Dantooine, Medical Sublevel, use the '???' challenge marker to call the Infinite Conduit Warden. Accept this assignment before using the marker.

Everything a current can do when it is hoarded. Strikes like a burst main; stillness like deep water. He will not tire -- he spends what he stole, and he stole years of it. One current breaks against him. Three currents, moving apart and together, pull him open. That is not tactics. That is plumbing. Bring two friends who can hold their own line.

Defeat the Infinite Conduit Warden in Dantooine, Medical Sublevel. Their defeat secures the Infinite Conduit Fractured Ward Sigil; bring it back to me here in Dantooine, Medical Interior. Use the '???' challenge marker there to begin the fight. Two companions are recommended.
You've defeated the Infinite Conduit Warden. Let me see the Infinite Conduit Fractured Ward Sigil.
The warden's watch is over. Your payment is ready. Speak to me again for the inner circle trial when you're ready.

Four senior practitioners still authorize the blocked flow. Recover the matron's token. Defeat four members of the Infinite Conduit Inner Circle in Dantooine, Medical Sublevel. Their defeat secures the Infinite Conduit Matron's Ward Token; bring it back to me here in Dantooine, Medical Interior.
Your key still grants access to Dantooine, Medical Sublevel. Defeat four members of the Infinite Conduit Inner Circle to secure the Infinite Conduit Matron's Ward Token, then return to me.

The first four I ever taught the conduit form. That is the wound underneath all of this, and now you know it. They understood the current perfectly and trusted it not at all -- and mistrust, in the end, is just a dam you build out of yourself. They are better than anything you have faced below, except perhaps the warden. Together, they may be better than him.

Use 'Dantooine Medical Sublevel' in Dantooine, Abandoned Warehouse. My key grants access. Keep your party close to the entrance when you use it so they can enter with you. Defeat four members of the Infinite Conduit Inner Circle in Dantooine, Medical Sublevel. Their defeat secures the Infinite Conduit Matron's Ward Token; bring it back to me here in Dantooine, Medical Interior.

Four currents braided into one defense. Press one and another answers. Unbraid them if you can; if you cannot, bring companions and braid your own. And spare the station itself -- every line in the sublevel crosses that room, and the ward above drinks from those pipes while you fight.

Defeat four members of the Infinite Conduit Inner Circle in Dantooine, Medical Sublevel. Their defeat secures the Infinite Conduit Matron's Ward Token; bring it back to me here in Dantooine, Medical Interior.
You've defeated four members of the Infinite Conduit Inner Circle. Let me see the Infinite Conduit Matron's Ward Token.
Their instructors no longer hold the authority to teach. Your payment is ready. Speak to me again for the final trial when you're ready.

Their master is the last obstruction. Defeat him in the Protected Ward and finish the conduit trials. Defeat the Infinite Conduit Master in Dantooine, Protected Ward. Report back to me here in Dantooine, Medical Interior; no item is needed for this final trial. I recommend bringing two companions for this fight.

In Dantooine, Protected Ward, use the '???' challenge marker to call the Infinite Conduit Master. Accept this assignment before using the marker. Bring two companions if you can. Once the master is defeated, come back for the final lesson.

The best of us. That is not sentiment; it is measurement. He moves the way the form promises -- endless, effortless, both blades one motion. But nothing leaves him anymore. Imagine a river that only accepts. When you see it, you will understand why I sent you to unmake the dams first. He is the last one, and he is beautiful, and he must come down.
In Dantooine, Protected Ward, use the '???' challenge marker to call the Infinite Conduit Master. Accept this assignment before using the marker.

The form itself, perfected and pointed at you. He will not surge like the specialists or hoard like the warden. He flows -- endlessly -- and one defender simply drowns in it. Three channels divide the current: while he pours into one of you, the others cut. Trade places before anyone empties. Whoever tires falls back to breathe. That rhythm is the entire battle.

Defeat the Infinite Conduit Master in Dantooine, Protected Ward. Report back to me here in Dantooine, Medical Interior; no item is needed for this final trial. Use the '???' challenge marker there to begin the fight. Two companions are recommended.
You've defeated the Infinite Conduit Master. Give me your report and we'll finish the trial.
The conduits can flow through the ward again. Carry that lesson with your staff. You've earned the right to train Infinite Conduit. Your final payment is ready.
Go back to the beginning. The adepts.
I'll defeat six Infinite Conduit Adepts.
What is the conduit form?
Where do I find them?
What waits below?
Not yet. Let me sit with this first.
Here's the Infinite Conduit Triage Ward Ledger.
The coupler -- walk me through it once more.
I'll defeat five Infinite Conduit Specialists.
What does the coupler do?
Where is their practice chamber?
How do the specialists fight?
Not today. The current and I need to talk first.
Here's the Infinite Conduit Kolto Conduit Coupler.
Say it again, slowly. The warden.
I'll defeat the Infinite Conduit Warden.
Who was he, before?
Where does he hold?
What can he do to us?
Then I'll wait for my companions. He will keep.
Here's the Infinite Conduit Fractured Ward Sigil.
The station. Tell me again.
I'll defeat four members of the Infinite Conduit Inner Circle.
Who are the inner circle?
Where is the matron's station?
How do the four defend together?
Let me gather myself first. Their lesson can wait for mine.
Here's the Infinite Conduit Matron's Ward Token.
Once more. I want every word of it.
I'll face the Infinite Conduit Master and report back.
What has he become?
Where is the reservoir chamber?
How do we survive him?
Not until my companions stand with me. The river can run a little longer.
The Infinite Conduit Master is defeated. Here's my report.
